notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Eldrazi Confluence exiled by Abdel Adrian.
description:
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning The Immortal Weapons and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and The Immortal Weapons trigger.
Resolve the The Immortal Weapons trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Eldrazi Confluence.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling The Immortal Weapons and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.
